partners.mechanism_chain: EVC (HGNC:2413) —DISRUPTS→ proteasome complex (GO:0005839); EVC2 (HGNC:2414) —DISRUPTS→ proteasome complex (GO:0005839); PSMC3 (HGNC:9554) —DISRUPTS→ proteasome complex (GO:0005839); proteasome complex (GO:0005839) —LEADS_TO→ Short limb polydactyly (HP:0005727); proteasome complex (GO:0005839) —LEADS_TO→ Neurodevelopmental delay (HP:0012444). Loss-of-function mutations in EVC, EVC2 (causative for Ellis-van Creveld syndrome) and PSMC3 (causative for Ebstein-Bezieau syndrome) all disrupt the function of the proteasome complex. Dysregulation of the proteasome complex leads to the accumulation of misfolded proteins and cellular dysfunction, manifesting as distinct but potentially overlapping phenotypes including short limb polydactyly and neurodevelopmental delay.
